subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should closing #86684 require both a runtime overflow-decision fix and a persisted compaction trigger/cause field, or should trigger metadata be split into a separate follow-up?
rationale: The runtime bug is clear enough to keep open, but persisted trigger metadata affects transcript schema and diagnostics policy, so automation should not choose that product boundary alone.

options.title: Fix Runtime And Cause Metadata
options.body: Keep #86684 open until low-context compaction is fixed and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

options.title: Split Metadata Follow-Up
options.body: Treat the premature compaction as this issue's required fix and track persisted trigger metadata in a narrower diagnostics issue.

options.title: Wait For Live Current-Main Repro
options.body: Pause implementation until QA or a maintainer reproduces the yielded-parent wake path on current main with redacted runtime logs.

recommendation.title: Fix Runtime And Cause Metadata
recommendation.body: Keep #86684 open until low-context compaction is fixed and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent context-engine and preflight overflow budgeting work makes jalehman the best available owner for the compaction-policy decision, with LZY3538 and steipete as code-history backups.
